descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Numbers — Reading, Composing, Comparing, Estimating, and Fair-Sharing Numbers to 200, plus Even/Odd and Halves/Thirds/Sixths (B1.1–B1.7)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-2 unit on Numbers (B1.1-B1.7), framed around Detective Hugo Hundreds, Tina Tens, and Ona Ones running the Place Value Detective Agency. Three-digit place value, composition/decomposition, comparison, estimation, even/odd, and fair-sharing with thirds and sixths all in one focused week.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Place Value Detectives — reading, composing, comparing, estimating, and fair-sharing numbers up to 200. Day 1 'Hundreds Hideouts' introduces three-digit place value with base-ten blocks and skip-counting by 20s, 25s, 50s on a 0-200 number line (B1.1, B1.4). Day 2 'Compose, Decompose, Compare' is the keystone: flexible decomposition (e.g., 147 = 100+40+7 = 130+17) and place-value comparison (B1.1, B1.2). Day 3 'The Even/Odd Investigation' tackles B1.5 with the pair-up test and connects to skip-counting by 2s. Day 4 'Estimation Stake-Out' upgrades the chunk-of-10 strategy to chunk-of-100 for collections to 200 (B1.3). Day 5 'Fair Shares with Thirds and Sixths' is the capstone: fair-sharing collections with 2/3/4/6 sharers (B1.6) and the pizza-overlay reveal showing 1/3 = 2/6 (B1.7). Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering 3 misconceptions paired with concrete recovery moves; mid-unit and end-of-unit assessments included.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson with name/date fields and child-voice learning goals
1 mid-unit formative assessment (Place-Value Check-In) administered between Lessons 3 and 4

13 printable teacher manipulatives plus 3 character puppets: base-ten blocks label, place-value mat, 0-200 number line (11 letter pages), 30 decomposition cards, 24 compare cards, snap-cube label, hundreds chart 1-100, estimation jars sheet, third/sixth pizza cards, share plates label, plus stick-puppet variants of Hugo Hundreds, Tina Tens, and Ona Ones
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 seven-row summative rubric covering B1.1-B1.7 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Junior Place Value Detective certificate (one per child) for the closing ceremony

Detailed expanded walkthroughs for every lesson including the place-value-as-position repair, the hundreds-first comparison rule, the last-digit rule for even/odd, the chunk-of-100 strategy upgrade, and the match-fraction-to-sharers move
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson: emerging learners, extending learners, ELL/IEP, and movement-first learners
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers covering the B1.1-B1.7 cluster of the 2026 Grade 2 Math curriculum. Useful as a 5-day unit at the start of the calendar year (September-October) or as a numbers review block in late winter before report-card cycle.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Concrete-Representational-Abstract progression across the 5 days. Real base-ten blocks, snap cubes, paper cookies, and pizza fraction cards anchor every concept before any worksheet abstraction. The keystone Lesson 2 builds flexible decomposition; the integration Lesson 3 connects pair-up test to last-digit rule; the upgrade Lesson 4 introduces chunk-of-100 for big collections; the capstone Lesson 5 reveals 1/3 = 2/6 via the pizza overlay. Differentiation is proactive (built into every lesson) rather than remedial.
